en-US.description: The PDF workbench; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Acrobat, rebuilt in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
The PDF workbench; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Acrobat, rebuilt in pure Rust.
Read, organize, combine, split and secure PDFs in a fast, native app, written in Rust from the ground up.
PdfCraft renders PDFs with care for the details that make a page feel right: kerning and ligatures, right-to-left and complex scripts, vertical CJK, colour emoji, shadings, blend modes, soft masks and optional content.
Combine files merges any number of PDFs into one. Each file gets a bookmark, with its own bookmarks nested underneath. Extract copies the pages you select into a new document. Split divides a document every n pages, or before the pages you choose.

- i18n(tr): translate the 288 strings the gaps report lists by @fatihkunak in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5795

- Add CSS-free HTML export by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5938
- Open: measure cached objects once, read plain reals without a copy, keep no /PieceInfo in inspection (#5873) by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5958
- Continue Bates numbering across ordered PDFs by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5953
- M5: keep Fill & Sign editing on Enter and preserve line breaks (#5850) by @AdrianTM in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5954
- fix(audit): read content one operator at a time and charge hidden text and findings by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5875
- fix(xfa): scripts come only from the XDP's own packets and quote the date pattern by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5987
- fix(engine): decode signature preview images within a small work allowance by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5981
- i18n: interface translations from craft-i18n by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6055
- i18n: move the craft-i18n pin to 575cfde by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6068
- Release: PdfCraft v0.18.1 by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6078

zh-CN.description: PDF 工作台；以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Acrobat 净室重实现
zh-CN.longDescription:
PDF 工作台；一个以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Acrobat 净室重实现。
在快速的本地应用中读取、整理、合并、拆分和保护 PDF，从零开始用 Rust 编写。
PdfCraft 的 PDF 渲染注重让页面看起来舒适的细节：字距与连字、从右到左及复杂文字、竖排 CJK、彩色 emoji、着色、混合模式、软蒙版和可选内容。
合并文件可将任意数量的 PDF 合而为一，每个文件都会生成一个书签，其原有书签嵌套其下。提取可将所选页面复制为新文档。拆分可按每 n 页或在所选页面之前分割文档。
